title: Perfect projection formula on arbitrary small ringed sites
statement:
Let $u:(\mathscr X,R_X)\to(\mathscr Y,R_Y)$ be a morphism of ringed topoi presented by small sites, with sheaves of commutative rings and structural map $u^{-1}R_Y\to R_X$ [def-weil-size-convention, def-weil-pbc-ringed-topos-morphism]. Use their ordinary unbounded derived categories of module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-weil-abstract-derived-category], with the canonical derived adjunction $L=Lu^*\dashv R=Ru_*$ and K-flat derived tensor [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-projection-mate-exact]. Let $E\in D(R_X)$ and let $P\in D(R_Y)$ be perfect, meaning that locally on the target site it is represented by a bounded complex whose terms are direct summands of finite free $R_Y$-module sheaves [def-weil-pbc-strict-perfect-coefficient-package]. Then the canonical projection morphism
$$\pi_{u,E,P}:RE\otimes^L_{R_Y}P\longrightarrow R(E\otimes^L_{R_X}LP),$$
defined as the adjunct of $L(RE\otimes^LP)\xrightarrow{\sim}LRE\otimes^LLP\xrightarrow{\varepsilon_E\otimes1}E\otimes^LLP$, is an isomorphism. No boundedness of $E$, global bound on the local perfect representatives, exactness of module pullback, cartesianness, or geometric finiteness hypothesis is imposed.
